digest.component_or_area: workflow editor and criteria policy engine
propositions: The workflow editor must expose a read-only Effective Policy view derived from CriteriaSnapshot that displays criterion provenance, gate, tier, posture, applicability, and enabled/disabled state without mutation or serialization back to YAML/BPMN.
Authored Workflow remains the only editable topology; the effective policy panel is configuration provenance only and must never serialize edits back into workflow or project routing.
Project code-review LLM criteria must have non-empty applies_to globs at authoring/save validation; missing or empty selectors are rejected with a repository-wide remedy suggestion.
Built-in criteria, project DET criteria, and plan-review criteria retain distinct trigger authoring controls and are not forced through the applies_to glob validation rule.
Snapshot load or validation failures must mark the Effective Policy view unavailable with actionable error messages and prevent save; no packaged defaults or silent fallbacks are substituted.
Editor payloads and responses must exclude execution trace, per-call debugging detail, discovery trace, prompt/context body, provider response, and secrets.
